svg.title: The WD1 log as a chain of units
svg.text: The log is 111 units, from 0 to 87 m, and strat:meets links each to the next
One segment per strat:StratigraphicUnit, by depth; the counts come from the query below, compared with a count made from the CSV.
units that are met by another
where a unit does not touch the next
Illustrative instances, built from Table 1 of the WD1 core; the strat: classes are planned.
